site.hero.tittel: Disponit is the platform shell for self-driving operations.
site.hero.tekst: The website and control plane can be complete now while modules are connected gradually. The platform shows honestly what is live, what is being built, and what remains planned.
site.argument.presisjon_tekst: Disponit does not market magic. The interface shows which modules are actually operational, which are missing, and which control gates govern rollout.
site.argument.plattform_tittel: Brings operations, policy and rollout together
site.argument.plattform_tekst: The same shell handles read views, policy, exceptions, customer admin and owner control. New modules are added without rebuilding the site.
site.argument.kostnad_tekst: Customers can meet a complete platform experience long before all 45 modules are implemented. Status and scope are explicit, not hidden.
site.klarhet_tittel: Complete platform shell, staged module delivery
site.klarhet.status_tekst: A dashboard card reflects real operational status, not sales language. Anything not delivered is marked building or planned.
site.klarhet.policy_tekst: The platform can be complete as a working surface before every action module exists, because authority, read views and control flow are delivered separately.
site.klarhet.deploy_tekst: New modules are connected without rebuilding the site. Layout and navigation are complete; capabilities activate when the gates are green.
site.arbeidsflyt.styring_tekst: Login, navigation, tenant framing and control surfaces can be complete before all business modules are active.
site.arbeidsflyt.policy_tekst: Authority can be modelled, read and administered in the same shell without claiming that undelivered modules are operational.
site.arbeidsflyt.evidens_tekst: Decisions, exceptions and future module status are gathered in one control surface with the same language and trust boundaries.
site.moduler_tittel: Modules that move the platform forward
site.moduler_note: These statuses are operational, not decorative.
site.login.kunde_tekst: Go to the customer's workspace for policy, exceptions and module status.
site.login.admin_tittel: Log in as owner or operations
site.login.admin_tekst: Go to the platform overview for rollout, tenants and control of further activation.
site.fase.fundament.tekst: Platform, security, audit, exceptions, identity and the first operational flows.
site.fase.operasjoner.tekst: Finance, customer follow-up, reporting and standardised work processes.
site.fase.autopiloter.tekst: End-to-end processes such as purchasing, campaigns, telephony and fraud watch.
site.fase.global.tekst: Localisation, compliance, continuity and portfolio control across markets.
site.modul.m1.tekst: Defines what the agents are actually allowed to do.
site.modul.m2.tekst: Makes every automated action traceable and reviewable.
site.modul.m37.tekst: Collects everything stopped by policy into one controlled queue.
site.modul.m38.tekst: Distributes work, capacity and model choice per tenant and flow.
site.tenant.nordvik.neste: M-38 when capacity and queue evidence are green.
site.tenant.bjorkli.neste: M-37 after the exception routines are signed off.
site.tenant.granmo.neste: Used as customer zero for rollout and internal operations.

ui.kundeadmin.undertittel: The workspace shows which modules the customer actually has, which are on the way, and where policy and integrations are governed.
ui.kundeadmin.workspace_tekst: This is the operational customer surface for status, roles, policy and further activation.
ui.kundeadmin.rolle.leser_tekst: can read status, decisions and history without changing anything.
ui.kundeadmin.rolle.godkjenner_tekst: can approve, reject and escalate exceptions within assigned limits. Policy activation is not part of the role.
ui.kundeadmin.rolle.policyforvalter_teks: can create and maintain drafts, and attest activation with four eyes.
ui.kundeadmin.integrasjon.epost: Email and messaging channels for alerts and collection
ui.kundeadmin.integrasjon.bank: Bank and payment surfaces for controlled disbursements
ui.kundeadmin.integrasjon.idp: Identity provider for login and role assignment
ui.kundeadmin.plattform_tittel: What is complete even before every module is
ui.kundeadmin.plattform.status_tekst: The customer sees which modules are truly live and which are still being built, without interpreting roadmap or sales language.
ui.kundeadmin.plattform.policy_tekst: Policy, access and exceptions can be governed in the same customer surface before every action module is activated.
ui.kundeadmin.plattform.utvidelse_tekst: New modules can be added without changing the customer's base surface, navigation or mental model.
ui.kundeadmin.moduler_tittel: What the customer has now, and what comes next
ui.kundeadmin.moduler_note: The list shows real status, not roadmap marketing.
ui.kundeadmin.moduler_ukjent: No module assignment is registered for this customer yet.
ui.kundeadmin.handlinger_tittel: Where the user goes next from here
ui.kundeadmin.handling.oversikt_tekst: See what was allowed, stopped and sent to exceptions over the last 24 hours.
ui.kundeadmin.handling.unntak_tekst: Go to the exception queue for cases that need human attestation or clarification.
ui.kundeadmin.handling.policy_tekst: See what the agents are actually allowed to do before changing authority.
ui.kundeadmin.policy_tittel: Control authority before new modules are activated
ui.kundeadmin.policy_tekst: Policy administration is where new authorities are prepared, validated and activated with attestation.
ui.kundeadmin.policy_lesing_tekst: Read the active policy and what the agents are allowed to do. Preparing and activating new authorisations requires the policy manager role.
ui.kundeadmin.neste_tittel: Activate gradually, not all at once
ui.kundeadmin.neste_tekst: Disponit can launch as a complete platform shell first, and expand in a controlled way with modules when each delivery is actually ready.
ui.admin.undertittel: The platform overview brings together rollout, phases and tenant status for owners and operations.
ui.admin.status_tekst: This view is used to track what is in production, what is rolling out, and which tenants go first.
ui.admin.utrulling.ci: CI and contract tests must be green before the next gate.
ui.admin.utrulling.staging: Staging with synthetic data and measurable evidence comes before production.
ui.admin.utrulling.kanari: Customer zero and small cohorts are used before broad rollout.
ui.admin.utrulling.rollback: Rollback must be prepared and traceable before activation.
ui.admin.tillit_tittel: Invariants that keep the platform honest
ui.admin.tillit.p1: No module is marked complete until operations, policy and evidence actually exist.
ui.admin.tillit.p2: Tenant context and access come from the session, not client payload.
ui.admin.tillit.p3: Status pages and admin surfaces can be complete while business modules are built stepwise.
ui.admin.kontrollplan_tittel: What the admin surface actually governs
ui.admin.kontrollplan.release_tekst: The surface shows which part of the platform is ready for further rollout, without conflating layout readiness with module readiness.
ui.admin.kontrollplan.tenant_tekst: Owners and operations can see which tenants are pilot, internal or next for activation in one overview.
ui.admin.kontrollplan.port_tekst: Staging, canary and rollback remain explicit steps in the control surface, not hidden operations outside the system.
ui.admin.faser_note: Each phase unlocks new modules, not new truths.
ui.admin.tenanter_tittel: Who is where on the journey
ui.admin.tenanter_egen_tittel: Where your customer is on the journey
ui.admin.tenanter_egen_note: The cross-customer rollout requires platform operations. Only your own tenant is shown here.

ui.admin.handling.policyadmin_tekst: Open policy administration when new authorities must be validated and attested.
ui.admin.handling.policy_lesing_tekst: Read which authorities apply right now. Activation requires a policy scope you do not have.
ui.admin.handling.unntak_tekst: Follow up cases that block further activation or require a manual decision.
ui.policyadmin.undertittel: Changing a policy changes the agent's authority. Review the diff and risk class before activation; activation requires four eyes.

ui.editor.velg_mal_hjelp: The draft starts from a complete, valid template for the industry. You edit the business-critical fields afterwards.
